title: ee.index_intake.v1
description: Redaction-safe telemetry for one search-index intake operation: the intake mode, document counts, rebuild-avoided savings, and any fallback-to-full reason. Counts and modes only; never stores document content or query text. See ADR 0078 (docs/adr/0078-incremental-index-intake.md).

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the intake telemetry was produced.

redactionStatus.description: Redaction posture: this telemetry holds only counts and modes.

intakeMode.description: How the index was advanced: full rebuild of all documents, incremental single/small-delta intake, or periodic segment/WAL merge maintenance.

docsTouched.description: Number of documents added, updated, or tombstoned by this intake.

baseDocCount.description: Document count in the compacted base index after this intake.

segmentDocCount.description: Document count in the uncompacted WAL/segment delta after this intake.

rebuildAvoidedCount.description: Number of full-index rebuilds avoided versus the full-rebuild-per-write baseline.

mergeCount.description: Number of segment/WAL merge (compaction) operations performed.

fallbackToFull.description: Whether this intake fell back to a full rebuild, and the closed-set reason if so.

occurred.description: True when the intake fell back to full_rebuild instead of an incremental delta.

reason.description: Closed-set reason for the fallback; present only when occurred is true.
